يصطخب (form VIII)

# يُصْطَخَبُ (yuṣṭaḵabu) /jusˤ.tˤa.xa.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
# يَصْطَخِبَ (yaṣṭaḵiba) /jasˤ.tˤa.xi.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَبَ (iṣṭaḵaba)
